payload.claim: No test in tests/test_finish.py or tests/test_cli.py ever inspects the commit message `commit_finish` writes. The real-git witness checks the parent sha, author identity, diff contents and worktree cleanup via `git show`/`git diff`, but never runs `git log -1 --format=%s` or similar. Changing the format string to drop `{batch_id}` entirely (e.g. just `"finishing layer"`) would leave every test green while the stated subject contract silently breaks.
